authorization: user requested search in project panels using PWM, regulon networks and WGCNA

WGCNA.discovery: no mass-selected input genes; signed network; deterministic seed; top variable genes only if needed; all filters before trait tests
WGCNA.below_floor: computed only as exploratory sensitivity, never reliable independent network evidence
WGCNA.species: biological libraries do not add species; trait tests at species level
WGCNA.validation: leave-one-species perturbation and module projection across panels; account all modules in multiplicity

regulons.distinguish: curated footprint, motif-permitted coexpression edge, binding and causal regulation
regulons.story_genes: exclude fixed story genes and TF self from activity score when testing group links

PWM.window: active native CAGE TSS if traceable; otherwise explicit reference-TSS scope
PWM.background: all eligible expressed promoters; length/GC/CpG/expression matched; include observed cases in null
PWM.family: adjust across every candidate/module/panel in declared test family
PWM.limitation: family-shared PWM does not identify a unique TF; no motif for kinase or RNA-binding LIN28

interpretation: no new mechanistic confirmation from RNA correlations alone
do not pool panels or conditions as independent specimens
retain fixed own5 and bird group memberships; native4/native3 not old7
